name: tedtoolkit-hyperframes-tutorials
description: Plan, resume, script, generate Fish narration, storyboard, produce, cover, validate, and package animated HyperFrames tutorials.

interface.longDescription: File-based workflows for planning and resuming tutorial courses, detecting stale artifacts, co-designing scripts and provisional storyboards, generating narration with Fish Audio from a saved voice model ID, finalizing storyboards against verified timing, producing HyperFrames videos and coherent course and lesson covers, and packaging verified offline learner releases.
defaultPrompt: Plan a coherent animated tutorial course with stable lesson workspaces.
Resume a partially produced course from its verified state and detect stale artifacts.
Generate narration.wav from an approved narration.txt with Fish Audio.
Co-design each lesson's script and provisional storyboard, then finalize it against generated narration timing.
Create a coherent course cover system and lesson covers from verified tutorial content.
